a1_porch.title: The Porch
a1_porch.text:
{{#if visits>0}}The door remembers you. It says nothing, which is worse.

{{/if}}Marrow Street ends here, at a house that should have been torn down before you were born. Three pumpkins grin on the steps. Somebody has carved them very carefully.

The door opens a hand's width before you knock. A voice inside, warm as a kettle, asks the old question.

a1_threshold.title: The Long Hall
a1_threshold.text:
{{#if stance=trick}}The voice laughs, delighted, and the hall lengthens to make room for the joke.{{else}}A bowl of candy waits on a side table. You take two. A stub of candle is pressed into your palm by nobody.{{/if}}

Doors line both walls. Each is shut. Each has a brass number that does not match its neighbours.

a2_foyer.title: The Foyer
a2_foyer.text:
The hall gives up and becomes a foyer, tall and chequered. A chandelier turns very slowly, the way a head turns when it hears its name.

{{#unless candle}}Without a light, the corners have the run of the place.{{/unless}}{{#if fear>=2}} Your heart is making itself known.{{/if}}

a2_parlor.title: The Parlor
a2_parlor.text:
A fire is burning for someone who is not here yet. The portrait over the mantel has been painted recently; the paint is still wet at the eyes.

The clock in the corner is eleven minutes from midnight and has been for some time.

a2_nursery.title: The Nursery
a2_nursery.text:
The candy is accepted. A small door you had not noticed lets you into a nursery where a mobile turns without wind.

The rocking horse rocks. The doll has been waiting with excellent manners.

a3_mirror.title: The Glass
a3_mirror.text:
In the mirror you are standing in the same room, holding the same breath. Someone stands behind you in the glass, and not behind you in the room.

They are polite enough not to speak first.

a3_cellar.title: The Cellar
a3_cellar.text:
The cellar is older than the house above it. Roots have come down through the vault to listen. Bones lie in tidy arrangements, as if someone tried very hard to be a good host.

Below the floor, something beats.

a4_marrow.title: The Marrow
a4_marrow.text:
Here is the heart of the house, and it is a heart. It hangs in a cathedral of ribs and beats for you specifically.

{{#if candle}}Your candle gutters but holds.{{else}}You have nothing to hold up against it.{{/if}}

choices.label: Blow out the candle and run

end_escape.title: Marrow Street
end_escape.text:
You are on the lawn, and the rain is ordinary rain. Behind you the house settles its shoulders.

In an upstairs window, somebody waves goodbye with your hand.

end_consumed.title: The Marrow
end_consumed.text:
It takes your name kindly, the way a host takes a coat.

You will be hung somewhere warm and brought out for guests.
